Messages.Body:
CLARIFICATION:
Can Angelica use her card text to gain intercept, overriding the "even though intercept is not yet needed" rule in [6.2.2.2]?

This is old, but states that she cannot: groups.google.com/forum/#!original/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/GO5ZEkZv8R8/2EqB99tjYb0J

Angelica, The Canonicus
Lasombra
Group: 2
Capacity: 10
Discipline: cel obf DOM OBT POT
Sabbat cardinal: Once each ={action that}= Angelica attempts to block, you may burn X master cards from your hand to give her +X intercept.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> KevinM wrote:
> CLARIFICATION:
> Can Angelica use her card text to gain intercept, overriding the "even though intercept is not yet needed" rule in [6.2.2.2]?
>
> Angelica, The Canonicus
> Lasombra
> Group: 2
> Capacity: 10
> Discipline: cel obf DOM OBT POT
> Sabbat cardinal: Once each ={action that}= Angelica attempts to block, you may burn X master cards from your hand to give her +X intercept.
>
She can use her cardtext to gain intercept when needed, but she can't use her cardtext to gain intercept when not necessary, as stated in Rulebook 6.2.2.2.

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body: But if she need 1 intercept, she can burn 11 master if she want, right ?

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Ohlmann wrote:
> But if she need 1 intercept, she can burn 11 master if she want, right ?
>
Yes, though that would require you to have 11 masters in your hand at that very moment.
